short_summary: USPTO provisional utility patent application receipt for HealthRate Inc, filed by Jeff Sage with inventor Tim Michaels, showing application number 63/707,441 and Patent Center number 67575019.
long_summary: The document is a receipt for a USPTO provisional utility patent application (Application Type: Utility‑Provisional) filed on 10/15/2024. It records the application number 63/707,441, Confirmation # 1561, and Patent Center # 67575019. The filing was made by Jeff Sage on behalf of HealthRate Inc, with Tim Michaels listed as the first named inventor. The correspondence address for HealthRate Inc is 701 S. Carson St Suite 200, Carson City, NV 89701, US.
